scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); const html = fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html', 'utf8'); fs.writeFileSync('backend/htmlFallback.js', 'module.exports = ' + JSON.stringify(html) + ';'); }"
